digest.component_or_area: GitHub Code Quality remediation (Pass 3) — reconcilers, test fixtures, batch runner
propositions: Environment inheritance bug in two reconciler functions: when no_sync=False, _env=None causes subprocess to inherit parent REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off, silently suppressing live sync pull; fix by building explicit env and stripping key on live path, with two regression tests
Dead capability flags _HAVE_ASTGREP defined but never used in test_conformance.py and test_coverage_reconstruction.py must be removed; test_engine_b.py retains legitimate use

BatchRunner.run signature inconsistency: ProductionBatchRunner has agent_runner optional, but base BatchRunner, DefaultBatchRunner, and CodeReviewBatchRunner do not; align all to match mypy override contract

Tier-2 verified-dead symbols across 10+ files must be removed (acli_graph._RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK, reconcile_check reverse maps, reads._SCRIPTS_DIR, resolve._REFUTE_ELIGIBLE_KINDS, test fixture constants)
New non-review (transform category) test required in test_validation_depth.py to prove input-contract validation is category-agnostic
All linting, type checking, and regression tests must pass; change lands only after LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 gates
